items.title: Explicit Chevalley-Warning-with-symmetry search is PPA_p-complete for prime p
items.author: Mika Göös; Pritish Kamath; Katerina Sotiraki; Manolis Zampetakis

items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine completeness chain turns symbolic max-degree monomial cancellation and free cyclic symmetry into efficient modulo-p grouping,then encodes Lonely_p using labeled polynomial gadgets while preserving explicit monomial input and total witness conditions.

primary.label: Formal Theorem3:for every prime p,explicit ChevalleyWithSymmetry_p is PPA_p-complete

proof_spans.label: Formal Section4 complete CWT/symmetry/labeled-CWT lemmas,explicit problem definition,membership algorithm and full Lonely_p-hardness construction with every local continuation/figure
Formal AppendixA complete inter-reducibility and SuccinctBipartite/TwoMatchings completeness proofs plus required restricted-Lonely Lemma44 continuation

contexts.label: Formal intro1.2 complete field/monic/cancellation/general-CW/symmetry intuition and natural explicit input context
Formal Section2 complete FNP/TFNP/reduction/circuit encoding,Bipartite/Lonely/Leaf definitions,local conventions and graph landscape
Formal Lemma44 exact prime-p/restricted-designated-vertex support required by AppendixA
